content.text:
I changed the retry wait in `_retryAction` in `packages/playwright-core/src/server/dom.ts` so it no longer needs page scripts. I haven't built or run anything, so it's untested.

Before, the wait between retries ran a `setTimeout` promise inside the page through `evaluateInUtility`. With JavaScript disabled that evaluation never resolves, so a retrying click hung. It now calls `progress.wait(timeout)`, which waits on the server side. The retry delays are unchanged (20, 100, 100 and 500 ms).

I also removed the `error:notconnected` check after the wait. That result only came from the in-page evaluation, so it can't happen with a server-side wait. Disconnected elements are still handled by the action itself.

I used `progress.wait` because `rafrafTimeout` in `frames.ts` already calls it. I didn't open its definition, so I haven't checked its behavior.
